services.title: Hardscaping
services.short_description: Paver patios, walkways, retaining walls, steps, and fire pits built on a base that holds.
services.long_description: Hardscape is the foundation of any landscape project and the part that fails first when it is rushed. We install paver patios, walkways, stairs, retaining and sitting walls, paver driveways, pool surrounds, fire pits, and outdoor kitchen bases, and we do the excavation, sub-base, and compaction that keeps them level years later. We help you choose the right material for the job, then install it correctly.

services.title: Landscaping
services.short_description: Design, planting, mulching, sod, drainage, and seasonal maintenance for the whole property.
services.long_description: Our landscape work covers design plans, bed preparation, planting of trees, shrubs, and flowers, mulching, sod installation, drainage solutions, and outdoor lighting, plus ongoing maintenance: mowing, trimming, edging, pruning, fertilization, irrigation startups and blowouts, and spring and fall cleanups. Every maintenance program starts with an assessment of your yard, beds, and lawn rather than a fixed package.

Rolls of sod being laid for a new lawn

services.title: Outdoor Living
services.short_description: Outdoor kitchens, built-in grills, fire features, pergolas, and lighting designed as one space.
services.long_description: We design and build complete outdoor living areas: paver patios, built-in grills and full outdoor kitchens, fire pits and fireplaces, pergolas, seating and retaining walls, walkways, water features, privacy plantings, and landscape lighting. The point is one coherent space rather than a patio with things added to it later, using materials that hold up through Northeastern Pennsylvania winters.

gallery.alt: Built-in stone fire pit with paver seating area
Landscape lighting along a paver walkway at dusk

services.title: Custom Decks
services.short_description: Composite and wood decks with permits pulled, 3D renderings, and warrantied workmanship.
services.long_description: We build custom decks in composite and wood, working with TimberTech, Azek, Fiberon, and TREX decking and RDI, vinyl, aluminum, and steel railing systems backed by manufacturer warranties we help you register. Every deck starts with 2D and 3D renderings, we pull the permits ourselves, and you get documentation on every component. Cascading stairs, split levels, built-in benches, privacy screening, pergolas, and lighting are all on the table.

gallery.alt: Composite deck with railing overlooking a wooded yard

services.title: Plunge Pools
services.short_description: Precast plunge and Soake pools sized for real backyards, installed and integrated.
services.long_description: Plunge and Soake pools are shallower and smaller than a traditional pool, which makes them fit lots where a full pool never would, and they use about 90% less water. We install precast concrete shells above ground, semi-inground, or fully inground in sizes from a 4'x4' cold plunge up to 8'x20', with tile, bench, step, and cover options, then integrate the surround into the patio and planting so it reads as one design.

gallery.alt: Pool with paver surround and landscaped border

services.title: Lawn Health
services.short_description: Aeration, dethatching, overseeding, and top dressing that fix the soil instead of the symptom.
services.long_description: Most lawns in Luzerne County do not struggle because the homeowner is not trying. They struggle because the soil is compacted, thatch is blocking water, or the root zone is too thin. We aerate to open tight ground, dethatch when a dead layer is trapping water and seed, overseed to rebuild density in the spots that fade every summer, and top dress to improve the soil without tearing the lawn up. We assess first — not every lawn needs every service.
